## Description

Applies fractional integration and Vector AutoRegressive modeling across macroeconomic leading indicators and asset class returns to capture persistent macro momentum and mean-reversion.

## Where it may fit

Global macro allocation, multi-asset tactical rotation during monetary policy cycles.

## Vehicles

Global Macro Hedge Funds, Tactical Asset Allocation Portfolios.

## Required data

Macroeconomic indicator series (CPI, GDP, yield curves), cross-asset return panels.

## Caveats

Fractional differencing parameter estimation requires robust historical sample windows.
